title: Import the shared MockAuthRepository from test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart instead of 7 duplicated private copies in the account test suite

evidence.quote: class MockAuthRepository extends Mock implements AuthRepository {}

why: A shared, public MockAuthRepository already exists in test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart, but every one of these 7 files (all in this one batch; ~30 across the repo) reinvents an identical private copy. Low runtime risk today (mocktail's Mock base class no-ops unimplemented members via noSuchMethod), but it's needless duplication that a future AuthRepository interface change has to be reconciled against N private near-identical definitions instead of one, and two of the account_picker files additionally duplicate ~100 lines of ProviderScope/fixture wiring between them (account_picker_screen_l1_test.dart's _Fixture/_buildFixture vs account_picker_local_data_missing_test.dart's _buildApp) with no shared harness module.
recommendation: Import MockAuthRepository from test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart in these 7 files instead of redeclaring it; extract the account-picker widget fixture (registry/userDb/auth/router setup + buildSubject) shared by account_picker_screen_l1_test.dart and account_picker_local_data_missing_test.dart into one harness file.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'class _MockAuthRepository extends Mock implements AuthRepository' learning_tracker/test/features/account returns 0 hits.
The 7 files import test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart's MockAuthRepository and all existing assertions still pass.
